claims: Early rounds of the 2026 Masters are April 9–10.
Weekend coverage of the 2026 Masters is April 11–12.
New early streaming coverage of the 2026 Masters is on Amazon Prime Video.
Extensive live free coverage of featured groups and Amen Corner of the 2026 Masters is available on Masters.com, the Masters App, and Paramount+.
All times in the 2026 Masters Tournament Viewing Schedule are Eastern.
Early coverage of the 2026 Masters on Thursday and Friday is on Prime Video from 1:00 p.m. to 3:00 p.m. Eastern.
Early coverage of the 2026 Masters on Thursday and Friday is on ESPN from 3:00 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. Eastern.
Early coverage of the 2026 Masters on Thursday and Friday is on Masters.com/App from 1:00 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. Eastern.
Weekend coverage of the 2026 Masters on Saturday and Sunday is on CBS from 2:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. Eastern.
Weekend coverage of the 2026 Masters on Saturday and Sunday is on Paramount+ from 2:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. Eastern.
Daily featured groups and holes coverage of Amen Corner for the 2026 Masters is from 10:45 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Eastern.
Daily featured groups and holes coverage of holes 15 and 16 for the 2026 Masters is from 11:45 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. Eastern.
Daily featured groups and holes coverage of holes 4, 5, and 6 for the 2026 Masters is from 8:45 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. Eastern.
The 2026 Masters Par 3 Contest is on Wednesday, April 8.
Par 3 Contest coverage of the 2026 Masters on April 8 is on ESPN from 2:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. Eastern.
Par 3 Contest coverage of the 2026 Masters on April 8 is on Masters.com/App/Disney+ from 12:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. Eastern.
Masters.com and Masters App provide free comprehensive live coverage of the 2026 Masters including every shot from every player.
Masters.com and Masters App provide Range Tracker for the 2026 Masters.
Masters.com and Masters App provide 3D shot tracking for the 2026 Masters.
Amazon Prime Video is new for 2026 offering data-driven feeds for the 2026 Masters.
Paramount+ streams CBS TV coverage of the 2026 Masters.
Paramount+ streams Masters on the Range for the 2026 Masters.
ESPN App streams ESPN coverage of the 2026 Masters.
